Lab 2

Structured Output

@llm-series/structured-output

LLMs return plain text. This lab shows how parseStructured() extracts JSON using regex, parses it, and validates it against a Zod schema — with specific errors at each step.

💡 extractJSON() finds the JSON block. JSON.parse() decodes it. Zod safeParse() validates the shape. Three distinct failure modes, three distinct error types.

Select a schema and click Run to see the extraction pipeline.
